result: Priya suggested a fish, and the team split the work. Leo started the nose, Priya and Tom took the body lines, and Maya took the tail tips. The body lines met at the tail, but the top tip kept showing pale. Maya bridged it, Leo hooked the body end into it, and Maya cleared the stray pieces. Priya took over the corner, and Tom's close look found the real problem: "the tip's a sharp turn off it." His idea was to hook the tip from the bottom body end instead. Priya made the last nudge at the joint while Maya and Tom kept their hands clear. Time was nearly up, and she was still mid-connect. When the start domino went, 105 of 122 fell.
